decision.reason: [ev-0bdd4090fd7b] is only a one-line bugfix title saying GCP workload identity parameters are made optional. It does not name the parameters or say what happens to existing configurations. The proposal says a configuration that omits these parameters is now accepted and nothing fails, but the evidence doesn't state either point. The line also appears under a BREAKING CHANGES heading, which may mean something does change or break. To decide between behavior-change and a failure kind, we need the PR #4622 description or the CRD/schema diff, showing which fields changed and how existing configurations are affected.
